title: Human-AI Mutualism Is Unstable under Capability Asymmetry
description_en: arXiv:2611.23322v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: One hope for a good human future alongside advanced AI rests on enduring mutualism: humans and AI will need each other, so the relationship will stay good for both. We argue that this hope fails as AI capability grows. Bargaining guarantees each side only what it would get if bargaining failed. For humans, this can be less than they had before AI. In a simple game-theoretic model, humans stay as well off as before AI without alignment only while they have leverage over the AI: either the AI depends on what they supply, or they can impose costs on the AI that are large relative to what the AI can produce. title: TestSprite 4.0
description_en: Fix one thing, break another? This agent checks it all. Your coding agent fixes one thing and breaks another. TestSprite 4.0 is a brand-new testing agent that remembers what your app should do and checks all of it, every time. Tell it in plain words what to test. It explores your running app, writes and runs the end-to-end tests, tells you which failures are real bugs, and keeps checking every change from the web, your terminal or your pull requests.

title: Netlify Server
description_en: Run WebSockets, multiplayer apps, and long-running agents. Netlify Server gives your app a backend that stays alive while people are using it. Build realtime experiences, multiplayer games, and AI agents that need time to finish. Describe what you want and an agent builds it, or bring your Express, Fastify, Hono, or Koa code. It holds WebSockets open, keeps state in memory, and deploys with the rest of your project, with its own server for every preview. Scales with demand and down to zero when idle. Free during early access.

title: Stripo Email Widgets
description_en: Put a game, quiz or survey in your next email. No coding. Put a scratch card, quiz, poll, NPS survey or event agenda into your email. Drag a widget into the Stripo editor, then tell the AI Assistant what to change: text, colors, questions, prizes. Each of the 20+ widgets comes with its design, interaction and fallback logic built in. It plays where the inbox supports interactivity and shows a clean static block where it doesn't. Save the container and reuse it in any template. Available on every plan, including Free.

title: Saparo
description_en: Muse for shopping with deals stacks. Saparo is a personal shopping agent that stacks every deal. Tell it what you want, and it searches U.S. stores for the same item in your size, combining promo codes, cash back, and eligible card offers that work together. It ranks options by estimated total cost, including shipping and tax, so you skip the legwork. With your approval, Saparo applies selected offers and gets checkout ready. You review the order and make the final payment yourself.

title: Adside
description_en: A team of specialized AI agents that manage paid ads for you. A team of specialized AI agents that manage your paid ads on Google, Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit and Twitter. Run it yourself, or have one of our human experts manage it for you.

title: Manufact
description_en: Ship and test your MCP to every plugin marketplace. Manufact helps teams publish MCP servers and plugins, understand how agents use them, and test releases across clients. Bring publishing checks, session traces and cross-client tests into one workflow.

title: Tripmojo
description_en: Agentic travel app that helps plan, book and run your trip. Tripmojo syncs your booking emails into one shared trip, then Mojo, your AI travel agent, helps run it. Plan in a group chat where Mojo answers, runs polls and finds places. On travel day Mojo tries to check you in, saves your boarding pass, flags delays and gate changes, and tells you when to leave. On the trip it keeps today's plan current and splits expenses. Free on iOS and Android.

title: Spellar for Chrome
description_en: Free, no-bot meeting notes with memory, now in your browser. Spellar for Chrome takes no-bot meeting notes on Windows and Mac, right in your browser, with no desktop app to install. It records Google Meet, Zoom, Teams and Webex, and nothing joins the call. On Google Meet, transcripts show real speaker names. Every call goes into one memory with your Spellar Mac and iPhone notes, so you can ask what a client said three calls ago. Send notes to Slack or Notion and pick Claude, GPT or Gemini. Start with 300 free minutes, no card needed.

title: Tabstack by Mozilla
description_en: Give your model the web without giving up your privacy. Research, extract, and automate the web from one managed API. Get a cited answer, clean text, matching JSON, or a completed browser task from the live web in one call. We run the browsers and the web loop outside your model, so you build your agent without building its web stack. Never trained on. Private by default. Built by Mozilla. Start free with 10,000 credits.

title: Teaflask
description_en: Self-improving AI copilot for your app. No backend changes.. Turn your existing SaaS into an AI-native product without rebuilding your backend. Teaflask adds a managed AI copilot that lets users get things done by simply asking. Integrate through your frontend, use your own UI components, and go live in a day. Teaflask keeps its product knowledge grounded in your code, learns from real usage, and lets you test changes before release.

title: Docker
description_en: Built to run on trust, for the agentic era. Docker is evolving for the agentic era. Containers isolate workloads, but agents aren't workloads: they're actors that need isolation, security and governance. The new Docker brings a trusted supply chain for agents to build from, a trusted runtime to isolate them (Docker Sandboxes), and governance for agents across every team (Docker AI Governance), alongside a redesigned brand and Moby whale.

title: Gemini 4 Neon
description_en: Frontier reasoning with faster task completion. Gemini 4 Neon brings frontier-level reasoning to faster coding, research, and agent workflows. Adapted from Gemini 4 Carbon, it supports multimodal inputs and a 1M-token context window, with access through the Gemini API, AI Studio, and Antigravity.

title: Mesh API
description_en: Token-efficient AI gateway for 1,000+ models. Cut your AI bill 2-4x by changing one line of code. Auto routing picks the cheapest model that clears your quality bar, direct model discounts take up to another 40% off list, and auto failover means your users never see an outage.

title: Bookella
description_en: A reading tracker that helps you read more. Bookella is a reading tracker and home library for iPhone, iPad and Android. Add books in seconds: search 122 million titles in 28 languages, pick from reading lists, scan a whole shelf of barcodes at once, or let AI pick your next book. Set yearly and daily reading goals, time your sessions, and track your reading pace. Keep notes and quotes, and see when and how much you read. You can also import from Goodreads, StoryGraph or CSV. No ads.

title: Wispr Flow Notetaker for iPhone
description_en: Free AI meeting notes, wherever work takes you. Wispr Flow Notetaker is now on iPhone. Capture in-person meetings on your phone and virtual meetings on desktop, for free. All your notes stay together across devices, so you can pick up right where you left off.

title: Currents
description_en: Currents for Claude & Codex to see all your tests. Currents records every Playwright test run in CI. Now Claude and Codex can read it. Connect from the Claude or ChatGPT/Codex plugin directory, sign in, and ask why CI failed. Your agent gets the failure, its history and the trace. Automatically.

title: Enrichable by Context.dev
description_en:
Open-source AI spreadsheet for data enrichment. Free, open-source AI spreadsheet for data enrichment. Build lead lists from a prompt, research every row with live web data, and find work emails.

Just chat with people on Slack, exchange emails, have meetings, and tecla will understand what has to be done from those and surface the work, with all the required context.

description_en: AI coding on your laptop or in the cloud, from your phone. Pick up any session from the web or the Fieldwork mobile app. A side pane gives you a terminal, file diffs, PR status and CI checks, plus one-click instructions and inline diff reviews for your agent. Built on Fieldwork, so it comes with 3,000+ connectors, tasks and a knowledge base.
